SPACE.note: free/total storage — the number the design refused to promise unmeasured

WF.note: WiFi FIRMWARE version — NOT credentials (this is the one I conflated)

WIFI.note: WiFi credentials the AP will use

WIFIS.note: status after cleanup — proves the teardown took

WIFIC.note: CLEAN UP / close the access point

refused.SK: writes a NEW session key. Would re-key the recorder and can break the phone's pairing — U1 (does a keyed recorder refuse a second APP&SK&?) is still open.
refused.REC: starts/stops recording on the owner's device. Not mine to trigger.
refused.U: begins a file transfer, which ties up the radio for minutes to hours.
refused.D: delete. Already validated NON-DESTRUCTIVELY with a sentinel that cannot exist: APP&D&1970-01-01&19700101000000 -> MCU&D&ERR, 19 recordings before and after.
refused.T: sets the device clock. Exists (pocket-libre set_time sends T&<YYYYMMDDHHmmss> and checks for MCU&T&OK) but it is a WRITE, and status already reports 'Time: Synced to host', so there is nothing to correct.
